subject: Novus MAP starter: template + proposed workshop and timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Davis <morgan@novus.ai>, Alicia Tran <alicia.tran@novus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Novus MAP starter: template + proposed workshop and timeline

Hi Morgan / Alicia —

Great to meet earlier on the call. Per our discussion, I attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and a starter slide deck to expedite the evaluation. The goal here is to give us a shared plan with clear owners, milestones, and a proposed 6-week close runway you can adjust.

What I attached:
- novus_map_template_v1.gdoc — MAP outline (Objectives, success metrics, stakeholders, milestones, risks, acceptance criteria, decision rails).
- MAP-starter-deck-v0.pptx — two-slide summary you can drop in an internal update.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick internal read by Novus (48 hours) — confirm primary stakeholders and an initial success metric.
2) 60-minute map workshop (we can run the first half as a technical run-through, second half as stakeholders + procurement cadence) — proposed slots below.
3) Finalize MAP and lock a pilot acceptance checklist.

Proposed workshop slots (PST):
- Tue Sep 21, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 22, 15:00–16:00

If neither works, tell us a few times and we’ll accommodate. I asked Marissa (SE) and Vivek (Account Exec) to join the workshop — they’ll help with technical gates and license/ops questions. Neha (CS) will own onboarding and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment stubs: novus_map_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc) — MAP starter; MAP-starter-deck-v0.pptx (PPTX) — two-slide summary.

Subject: Re: Novus MAP starter: template + proposed workshop and timeline

Thanks Sergio — this is helpful.

Couple quick asks from our side:
- Can you provide a one-page timeline that maps out the 6-week runway (key milestones and deliverables) so our VP of Product can scan quickly?
- We’ll need a RACI-style owner list for each milestone (that helps speed procurement).
- For the workshop, we prefer morning slots but can do Tue Sep 21 at 10:00 if that’s still open.

Also looping in Alicia from procurement — she’ll share contract timelines and any checklist items we need to complete on our side.

Appreciate it — I’ll review the doc and slide this afternoon.

—Morgan

morgan@novus.ai | (646) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Novus MAP starter: template + proposed workshop and timeline — quick pass

Morgan — thanks for the quick turn. I did a fast pass on the MAP and created a condensed timeline + RACI rows inside the same GDoc (link below). I also added a short technical readiness checklist under Week 1 that aligns to our sandbox access and a recommended pilot dataset size.

GDoc (MAP starter, editable): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovusMAP

Key edits I made (high level):
- Timeline: Week 0 (kickoff + access), Week 1 (sandbox + smoke tests), Week 2–3 (pilot execution), Week 4 (evaluate/QA), Week 5–6 (acceptance + go/no-go).
- RACI: we called out Novus owners (Morgan, Alicia) vs Redwood leads (Vivek — commercial, Marissa — SE lead, Neha — onboarding) per milestone.
- Risks: I flagged data retention and network egress as items procurement often asks for; added links to our compliance FAQ.

I updated a simple one-page timeline block at the top; you can snapshot that into your VP slide. If helpful, I can export a PDF one-pager before the workshop.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

A couple items from procurement:

- We also need a sample SOW timeline and an approximate date when we could expect standard contract terms.

We can confirm Tue Sep 21, 10:00. For the workshop, plan for two sets of stakeholders: Product + ML (technical), and Procurement + Finance (commercial). If you can provide the one-pager PDF and the two-slide summary ahead of the workshop (by end of day Mon Sep 20), that would be ideal.

Per Alicia’s ask, I attached:
- novus_map_template_v1.gdoc (now contains Marissa’s timeline + RACI) — editable link included in Drive.
- MAP-starter-deck-v0.pptx (updated) — includes one slide with a 30-day pilot run-rate estimate and a suggested SOW timeline.

- Morgan / Alicia: confirm the list of attendees for both technical and commercial tracks by EOD Mon Sep 20.

- Redwood: Marissa will run the technical section; Neha will cover onboarding and acceptance gates; Vivek and I will cover commercial and contract timeline.

HubSpot link to the deal: HS-Deal-4382 (I updated the MAP to the HubSpot record).

If that looks good I’ll drop the final Drive links in the calendar invite.

See you Tuesday —
